notes.subject: שמן ראש אל יני ראשי
notes.rationale: Oil for the head that my head must not refuse — some read 'it shall not injure/wound my head' (KJV 'break'), others 'my head does not refuse it' (JPS, YLT).

notes.subject: khesed
notes.rationale: חסד rendered as the fixed term khesed, not as generic kindness.

notes.subject: כי עוד ותפלתי
notes.rationale: 'for still my prayer continues' (ASV) vs 'my prayer is against/over their evil deeds' — Hebrew syntax is compressed.

translation: Man stretpela i ken paitim mi — em i khesed; na i ken skelim mi stret — em i ol bilong hed; no ken ring, hed bilong mi i no ken rifusim ⟨em⟩; bilong yet, pregare bilong mi i stap yet long ol samting nogut bilong ol.
